content.title: The Political Ecology of Artisanal and Small-Scale Mining in Eastern DRC: Roads, Flesh, and Minerals
content.abstract: This dissertation examines the political ecology of artisanal and small-scale mining in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo through the interrelated categories of roads, flesh, and minerals. Focusing on North and South Kivu, and especially on the Shabunda road and its surrounding extractive spaces, it asks how mining continues under conditions often described as crisis, fragility, or infrastructural collapse.
